dash.title: Dashboard
dash.connect_desc: Give Claude, ChatGPT or another MCP client permission to read and write your site.
dash.edit_desc: Browse the folder tree, edit Markdown, upload images and manage sharing links.
dash.view_desc: Open your site the way you see it when signed in.
dash.no_recent: No changes yet. Create a page or connect an AI to get started.
dash.first_prompt: Suggested first prompt for your AI
dash.first_prompt_text: Use tmp to create /research/circle.md from this conversation. Read any existing page before changing it.
content.title: Content
content.empty: This folder is empty. Create a page or ask your AI to write one.
content.delete_confirm: Delete this? It moves to the trash and any sharing links for it are revoked permanently.
content.upload_help: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MiB, or a PDF up to 20 MiB
content.col.name: Name
editor.title: Edit
editor.path_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores; pages end in .md, for example /research/circle.md
editor.save: Save (visible to active link holders immediately)
editor.conflict: This page changed while you were editing (now revision {rev}). Your text is preserved below; reload the current version, merge your changes and save again.
editor.invalid: The content could not be saved.
editor.unsaved_kept: Your unsaved text has been kept.
format.title: Format guide
format.frontmatter.title: (200 chars)
format.frontmatter.rules: Unknown top-level keys are rejected. The title falls back to the first heading, then the file name. If the first heading equals the title it is shown once.
format.markdown: Supported Markdown: headings, paragraphs, emphasis, blockquotes, ordered/unordered/task lists, fenced code, tables, links, images, thematic breaks. Raw HTML is rejected outside code blocks.
format.paths.root: means the site root; relative links resolve from the page's folder.
format.paths.links: External links may use https, http or mailto. Images may be local assets or external https URLs.
history.title: History
history.restore_confirm: Restore this revision as a new revision?
trash.title: Trash
trash.note: Restoring a deleted document does not reactivate its old sharing links.
settings.title: Site settings
settings.org_name_help: Shown as the site name when tmp.yaml has no name. Changing it never changes your organization code or URLs.
server.title: Server
server.ai_help: One key for this whole installation. It pays for every organization's filing calls, and each organization still decides separately, in its own settings, whether its content may be sent at all.
server.ai_key_set: A key is stored ({hint}). Leave the field as it is to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it. Clear it to turn filing off everywhere.
server.ai_key_none: No key is stored, so filing uses the rule-based fallback for every organization.
server.ai_workspace_help: Only for organization-level keys that are not scoped to one workspace.
server.ai_rejected: Saved, but the provider rejected the key:
server.ai_env_managed: This key is set by the server environment (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), so it cannot be changed here. Unset that variable to manage the key from this page.
server.consent_help: Nothing leaves this server until an organization's owner turns filing on. When they do, a call sends the folder list, page titles, and the first 2,500 bytes of the document being filed. Audit rows record the model, token counts and outcome, never the content.
settings.config_help: Theme, appearance, navigation and sidebar. Invalid configuration is rejected and the previous configuration stays active.
connections.title: Connections
connections.howto_claude: Claude (Desktop or web): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Paste the MCP URL and leave the OAuth client fields empty; Claude registers itself. Complete the sign-in and consent screens.
connections.howto_chatgpt: ChatGPT: Settings → Connectors → Advanced → Developer mode → Create. Paste the MCP URL and choose OAuth; ChatGPT registers itself.
connections.howto_note: Remote clients connect from the vendor's cloud, so this server must be reachable over public HTTPS. A localhost URL only works with a local test client.
connections.revoke_confirm: Revoke this connection? The client loses access immediately.
connections.api_tokens_help: For command-line and script access to the REST API. Shown once, stored hashed, expire within 30 days.
connections.token_created: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
share.title: Sharing links
share.label: Label (optional)
share.warning: Anyone with this link can view and edit this document.
share.created: Copy this link now. It is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.
share.none: No sharing links for this document.
share.revoke_confirm: Revoke this link? Anyone holding it loses access immediately.
shared.notice: You are editing through a sharing link. Saved changes are visible to the owner and everyone holding this link.
shared.name: Your name (optional, unverified)
shared.access_ended: Access to this document has ended. Your unsaved text is kept in this browser; copy it before leaving.
shared.draft_exists: An unsaved draft from this browser exists.
shared.form_expired: the form expired; copy your text, reload and try again
export.title: Export
export.desc: Download a ZIP of your current Markdown, tmp.yaml, folders and images with paths preserved. Deleted pages, history, credentials and sharing links are not included.
consent.title: Authorize {client}
consent.scope.content:write: Create and update pages and configuration
consent.notice: Edits saved by this client are immediately visible to anyone holding an active sharing link for the edited document.
consent.dynamic: This client registered itself as {id}. The name is supplied by the client and is not verified. It will redirect to:
oauth.rejected_detail: Unknown client or unregistered redirect URI. Only preregistered clients with exact redirect URIs may connect.
site.empty_dir: This folder has no pages yet.
error.404_detail: There is nothing at this address, or you do not have access to it.
error.500_detail: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
common.unauthorized: You are not authorized to do this.
landing.signin_failed: That username and password do not match.
landing.signin_authorize: Sign in to authorize {client} to access your site.
admin.title: Admin
admin.address_help: The permanent private address of your site. Only you and your connected clients can open it.
admin.links_help: Every secret link across the site. Revoke here, or manage a page's links from the page itself.
admin.links_none: No sharing links exist yet. Create one from a page's Share action.
tools.title: Owner tools
editor.not_text: Only pages and tmp.yaml can be edited as text.
new.title: New in {dir}
new.name_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores. End the name with .csv, .json or .txt to create a file instead of a page.
move.help: Pages end in .md. The old address keeps redirecting to the new one, and sharing links keep working.
connections.howto_code: Claude Code: run `claude mcp add --transport http tmp {url}` then /mcp to authenticate.
file.rows_truncated: Showing the first 1,000 rows. Download the raw file for everything.
new.ext_hint: Type a name with .csv, .json, .txt or another file extension to create a file instead of a page.
quick.title: Quick add
quick.lead: Paste a note, a table or a file. tmp reads your folders and suggests where it belongs; you confirm before anything is saved.
quick.placeholder: Paste Markdown, CSV, JSON or plain text…
quick.hint_placeholder: e.g. meeting notes for the mobile app
quick.heuristic: (Rule-based suggestion; connect an AI key in the server config for smarter filing.)
admin.ai_on: Placement suggestions use {model}. Only the folder list, page titles and the first part of the new text are sent; results are never stored.
admin.ai_off: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is configured, so Quick add and tmp_write path "auto" use rule-based filing.
quick.heuristic_fallback: (The model was unavailable, so this is a rule-based suggestion. The admin overview shows the last error count.)
settings.ai_help: When on, Quick add and tmp_write with path "auto" send your folder list, page titles and the first part of the new text to Anthropic ({model}) to suggest where the page belongs. Nothing is sent when this is off, and suggestions fall back to rules. Off by default.
settings.ai_unavailable: This server has no model configured, so filing is rule-based and no content leaves it.
settings.ai_toggle: Send excerpts to the model to suggest placement
settings.danger_help: Deletes your organization and account: every page, revision, file, sharing link, API token and AI-client connection, immediately and permanently. Export first if you want a copy.
settings.delete_confirm: Type your organization code to confirm
settings.delete_mismatch: The organization code did not match; nothing was deleted.
